test_case.test_name: ED-24 independent Common Refcode change-default and initialization restoration
test_case.purpose: Independently prove an approved Common Refcode project change persists and restore the explicitly selected factory or project target without CPU, memory, UPI, PCIe or critical-device initialization regression.
required_package: Qualified BIOS/KVM operator and maintenance window
Reversible refcode value/dependencies and initialization oracle
Backup, recipe application and KVM/physical/CMOS recovery plan
test_case.test_command: For this row only, capture baseline page/inventory; change one approved reversible refcode control/group, save/reboot and prove retention plus full initialization. Invoke firmware Load Defaults and record its factory page/inventory. If DEFAULT_TARGET=PROJECT_RECIPE, apply the approved recipe and reboot. Compare final page, CPU/memory/UPI/PCIe/critical-device inventory and preserved errors to the selected target.
test_case.expected_result: The approved change persists; each phase meets signed POST/inventory/error criteria; factory output is recorded separately; final state exactly matches the selected Factory Default or Project Recipe matrix.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS only against declared DEFAULT_TARGET with row-specific screens and cross-subsystem evidence. Factory values cannot satisfy a Project Recipe case. Wrong persistence/restoration, inventory drift, no-boot or disallowed error is FAIL. Missing target/matrix/recovery is BLOCKED.
safety_gate: Gate CLOSED until DEFAULT_TARGET, matrices, safe refcode value/effects and recovery are signed.
Never execute all/random or unqualified early-initialization controls.
Back up project settings; preserve logs/inventory and use only this row's evidence.
Operator controls save/reboot/default/recipe/recovery; no automatic retry or CMOS clear.
expected_evidence: Exact row/variant/hash, ED-11/ED-24 approval and platform/refcode identity
Declared target, factory/project matrices and reversible change rationale
Unique baseline, changed, retained, Load-Defaults, optional recipe and final screenshots
Backup/restored state, discrepancy/recovery record and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: Stop on initialization, inventory, error or boot anomaly and preserve evidence. Qualified personnel restore the backed-up project state through signed KVM/physical/CMOS recovery; do not copy prior-row evidence or blindly retry.
